name: Test: FNA small gaps (C#)
author: test
summary: FNA constructors, operators and ToString on the game's structs (Point, Vector3/4, Quaternion, Plane, Color, KeyboardState, MouseState, Viewport, GameTime, Point16) and the bounding math ported from FNA (BoundingBox, BoundingSphere, BoundingFrustum, Ray, Curve), checked against the game's own methods; ColorConverter, new Effect(bytes)/Clone with parameter metadata and annotations, Texture2D.SaveAsPng, DrawString/MeasureString with StringBuilder and the extra SpriteSortMode values.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csfnagaps. In the world, logs 'csfnagaps <case>: ok | FAIL' and 'csfnagaps END pass=N fail=M'.
